title: Countershape ReductionGrade v1 canonical body
description: The exact outward grade field set constructed by internal/reduction. A valid in-memory ONE_MINIMAL_UNDER grade is created only after store.Validate reopens the exact CompletedSweepDraft and the finalizer binds it to the live ReductionRun. This schema and its example are inert documentation; no parser or public grade constructor accepts these bytes.
$comment: Weak grades bind the run and reducer set but carry an empty completed_sweep_digest plus the explicit missing-authority limitation. Strong grade bytes record a completed-sweep digest but cannot recreate the opaque store capability that authorized construction.

reducer_set_digest.description: The exact governing reducer-set identity. It is the displayed quantifier only for ONE_MINIMAL_UNDER.
